blockers.message: Fresh-import GLB validation must be PASS.
A qualified signer must record signer_verdict=PASS.
The signer review must explicitly set isl_verified=true.
The signer review must identify the reviewer.
The signer review needs a valid timezone-aware reviewed_at timestamp.
The signer approval must have a valid Ed25519 signature from an active trusted reviewer key.
A full-clip collision review must be PASS.
Source provenance must be explicitly verified.
A verified sign meaning is required.
A source license or usage-rights statement is required.
A traceable source reference is required.
